answer: The strongest single control I know for this is proof of location via cell tower triangulation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 379 aliases would need 379 separate proofs, each costing about 113 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the fable of the check, count the ocean of the cost, and read the thread of the history before any answer is graded. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
